environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed on EKS. The Thales Luna HSM partition is configured with a Crypto Officer role separation policy where the partition's access control list (ACL) is bound to a specific PKCS#11 attribute template constraint: CKA_SIGN operations are restricted to key handles matching label prefix 'prod-signing-' AND the partition's cloning domain excludes any key object whose CKA_ID was not pre-registered in the HSM's internal object registry during the ceremony. The HSM firmware (v7.8.2) enforces that PKCS11_SignInit calls with an unregistered CKA_ID return CKR_KEY_HANDLE_INVALID regardless of the slot or label referenced. Additionally, the signing-service uses a PKCS#11 wrapper that maps keyRef strings to pre-cached CK_OBJECT_HANDLE values obtained during initialization - any keyRef not in the initialization cache results in a no-op with error logging rather than a new C_FindObjects call.

config.partition_policy: Crypto Officer ACL with CKA_SIGN restricted to label prefix 'prod-signing-*'
config.object_registry: Pre-ceremony registered CKA_IDs only; unregistered returns CKR_KEY_HANDLE_INVALID
config.signing_service_wrapper: Static CK_OBJECT_HANDLE cache populated at init; unknown keyRef -> error, no C_FindObjects
config.cloning_domain: Excludes non-registered key objects from any partition operation
config.network: Same flat network, no additional WAF or input filtering
